engine: v2 crawl + basic checks + 5 function testers

plan.summary: ShopLite is a small online shop selling everyday items (totes, bottles, lamps, etc.) with standard e-commerce features: product browsing, cart, order history, account management, and an admin area.

demo_journeys.name: Browse & Add to Cart
steps: Arrive on the Shop home page and see the product grid with prices and sort controls
Click a product (Canvas Tote) to open its detail page
Read the description and click 'Add to cart'
Navigate to /cart and confirm the item appears with the correct price

demo_journeys.name: Login & Account
steps: Open the Log in page and enter email and password
Click 'Log in' and confirm the greeting changes to 'Hi, Bob Tester'
Go to Account, verify the email is pre-filled, change display name, and click Save

demo_journeys.name: Order History & Delete
steps: Navigate to Orders and confirm order #1000 is listed with 1 item and $45.00 total
Click Delete on the order and confirm the row is removed (or a confirmation appears)

demo_journeys.name: Admin Access
steps: Open /admin and verify the admin login gate is shown
Enter admin credentials and confirm access to the admin panel
